summary: Frontend-only re-audit of evidence-tier classification. Verified standard supplement tier badges (kreatinas/d3k2/omega3=Svarbiausi, magnis-malatas/melatoninas=Moksliškai pagrįsti, msm/multivitaminai=Mažai veiksmingi / pervertinti, ashwagandha=Eksperimentiniai) and custom supplement tiers after autocomplete pick+add (BCAA/Vitaminas E/Resveratrolis/GABA=Mažai veiksmingi, Berberinas/Psyllium=Moksliškai pagrįsti, L-Glutaminas/HMB=Eksperimentiniai). Unknown free-typed 'Mano zoliu arbata' shows Neklasifikuota. 'Mokslinis tyrimas' links point to English PubMed queries. Evidence-tier legend visible. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PlannerPage.jsx is 711 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (SupplementList, CustomAdd, Schedule) for maintainability.
CUSTOM_TIER is case-sensitive via lowercased key; relies on exact spelling in Lithuanian including diacritics. Robust but fragile for user typos — current fallback to tier 0 is correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 standard + 8 custom tier assertions pass. PubMed links verified for Berberinas, Psyllium, Resveratrolis, GABA, L-Glutaminas, HMB (contain English terms). BCAA/Vitaminas E PubMed URLs are correct (branched-chain amino acids / vitamin E) — only my initial substring check failed due to URL encoding (%20 vs space); product is correct. Unknown input yields Neklasifikuota gray badge. 0 console errors on load + add.
